title: Third Season of New 'Ranma ½' Anime Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website of the new Ranma ½ anime series revealed additional cast and a key visual (pictured) for its third season on Saturday. The anime series adapting Rumiko Takahashi 's romantic comedy manga will premiere on Nippon Television at 12.55 a.m. on October 4.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Bleach’s Final Season Confirms Disappointing Episode Count For Hulu Return
content: Hulu has confirmed how many episodes Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War’ s final season is going to be running for, and it’s going to disappoint fans who have been looking forward to the anime’s grand finale.
author: ComicBook

title: BLEACH: TYBW Part 4 - The Calamity Opening & Ending Movie Videos Revealed
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 The Calamity revealed the opening and ending movie videos following the anime’s premiere today. The anime begins today, July 25, following its first three episodes’ early release in US theaters . Hulu recently confirmed that it will run for 10 episodes .
author: Anime Corner

title: Live-Action Series Spooky in Love Gets Webtoon Adaptation
content: The live-action Korean Netflix series Spooky in Love has received an official webtoon adaptation. The webtoon launched on Naver Webtoon on July 17 and updates weekly. An international rollout across seven countries is also planned for mid-August.
author: ANN

title: Shiori's Diary's Tsuya Tsuya Launches New Manga
content: This year's eighth issue of Akita Shoten 's Young Champion Retsu magazine announced on Tuesday that manga creator Tsuya Tsuya will launch a new manga titled Akatsuki no Logos (Logos of the Dawn) in the magazine's next issue on August 18.
author: ANN

title: Ranma 1/2 Season 3 Reveals Key Visual, October 3 Premiere, New Cast Including Masako Nozawa and Mayumi Tanaka
content: Ranma 1/2 has unveiled a new key visual for Season 3, while also confirming that the new season will premiere on October 3. The announcement was made during the series’ official “Dota-Bata Martial Arts Fan Meeting” event held on July 25.
author: Anime Corner

title: BLEACH: TYBW Part 4 - The Calamity Officially Confirmed for 10 Episodes by Hulu
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 The Calamity will officially run for 10 episodes, as confirmed by Hulu. The streaming platform posted on X to reveal that the final part’s episode count. It’s set to begin today, July 25, following its first three episodes’ early release in US theaters .
author: Anime Corner

title: Toei Animation Produces New 'Ginga Tetsudou 999' Theatrical Anime Adaptation
content: Toei Animation announced a new theatrical anime adaptation for Ginga Tetsudou 999 ( Galaxy Express 999 ) anime franchise on Saturday. The new film features a story concept by Rintarou ( Ginga Tetsudou 999 (Movie) , Sayonara Ginga Tetsudou 999 director) and animation production by Toei Animation.
author: MyAnimeList

title: New Galaxy Express 999 Theatrical Anime Announced With Story by Rintarō
content: Toei Animation announced on Saturday it is producing a new anime film based on Leiji Matsumoto 's Galaxy Express 999 franchise. title: Anime Limited Licenses Banana Fish Anime
content: Netflix had announced earlier this month that it will stream the anime in "select regions" starting on August 12. Anime Limited confirmed the anime will be available on Netflix in the U.K., Ireland, the U.S., Canada, and France. Netflix 's stream will include English and French dubs.
author: ANN
